Sanjana Chatterjee
Senior DevOps Engineer | Bengaluru
sanjana.chatterjee521@example.com | +91 9122807888

Seasoned DevOps and SRE professional with a background spanning platform reliability, automation, and cloud-native infrastructure. Focused on reducing incident surface, accelerating delivery through CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code, and mentoring teams on observability and runbook practices. Immediate joiner.
